string.text: Tritium inserts
Installing luminous inserts in sights allows you to increase the speed of aiming and the convenience of firing in the dark.
Butt pad
Allows you to soften the recoil from a weapon shot.
Replacing the handguard
Installing a plastic forend with Weaver-type mounts allows you to install additional sights, a flashlight and a laser laser on the weapon.
Dovetail mount
Allows installation on weapons of most sights manufactured in Warsaw Pact countries.
Laser pointer

Visually indicates the location of the intended hit on the target, greatly facilitating and speeding up aiming, as well as having a demoralizing effect on the victim.Does not interfere with the installation of a tactical flashlight and can be used in conjunction with it.
Tactical flashlight

A long-range, narrowly focused flashlight is indispensable for night trips, as well as for exploring dark rooms.Does not interfere with the installation of a laser pointer and can be used in conjunction with it.
Anatomical handle
Allows you to increase the ease of use of weapons.
High capacity magazine (black, 45 rounds)
Allows you to reduce the number of reloads in battle, increasing your chances of staying alive.
High capacity magazine (brown, 45 rounds)
Allows you to reduce the number of reloads in battle, increasing your chances of staying alive.
High capacity magazine (60 rounds)
Allows you to send even more opponents to the best of two worlds with one burst.
Light alloy parts
Replacing weapon parts with their light-alloy counterparts allows you to reduce the weight of the weapon.
Barrel adjustment
Increases the initial speed of a bullet's departure and has a beneficial effect on the accuracy of firing.
USM calibration
Individual fitting and balancing of standard parts of the firing mechanism allows for higher shooting accuracy while reducing recoil.
Forcing USM
Refinement of trigger units makes it possible to increase the rate of fire of weapons, unfortunately, at the cost of some reduction in reliability.
Heavy Duty Parts
Replacing weapon parts with their counterparts made of more durable alloys can significantly increase the reliability of weapons.
